properties.description: Both response valids clear after a synchronous reset edge. Pre-edge reset presentations retain their ordinary meaning.
A blocked data response preserves valid, data and last across the next edge, unless that edge resets the controller.
A blocked status response independently preserves valid and all status fields across the next edge, unless reset cancels it.

Every data presentation, including blocked presentations, matches the next accepted input byte or justified zero padding. Partial accepted prefixes are supported; unaccepted bytes cannot justify output. Tracking is bounded to 63 outstanding frames per channel.

Every status presentation describes the next completed accepted frame, with exact original length, length clamped to 4..8, and exact padding and truncation flags. Status consumption is independent of data consumption.

Last identifies the adjusted output boundary, supporting streaming prefixes and truncation. After 128 consecutive no-offer, both-ready edges, no incomplete accepted input or outstanding tracked response remains. Reset discards the previous epoch.
